proposed_edges.relationship: Beard challenges the class-struggle formula she attributes to Marx when treated as a total explanation of history, arguing that it reduces human thought and action to material interests and leaves too little room for historical agency.

proposed_edges.relationship: Beard criticizes Freudian literary interpretations that portray women chiefly as servants of male sexual drives and as neurotic, treating this as a reduction of women’s historical presence.

The endpoint is the Freudian-psychoanalysis grouping, not an assertion that Freud personally wrote every interpretation criticized or that all psychoanalytic work shares it. P94–97separately reports Adler’s break and Beard’s objection to his individual-psychology remedy; Adler’s statements are not silently attributed to Freud or Beard.
